hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: The open call does not require Chilean nationality or revalidación of a doctorate. It states: “Ser chileno(a) o extranjero(a) con residencia en Chile y domicilio en el país al momento de iniciar sus labores.” It also accepts “programas nacionales acreditados o sus equivalentes extranjeros”. Thus, a foreign doctorate is accepted, but Chilean residence and domicile are required when work starts.

international.notes: The official Medicine curriculum includes an English-language subject (“Inglés B1-II”), but no official evidence was found that medical/clinical content courses are taught in English. The International Relations office supports cooperation, teaching and student exchange; its published contact is direccionrrii@utalca.cl.

profile_paragraphs: UTalca’s Facultad de Medicina was founded in 2009. Its Medicine school project began in 2007 and received formal university approval in August 2008. The faculty is based at Campus Pehuenche in Talca, Maule.

Medicine is a seven-year, in-person Médico/a Cirujano/a programme based at Campus Pehuenche. The faculty reports that its first cohort graduated in 2015 and that undergraduate and medical-specialty activity has been held at Campus Pehuenche since 2021.

Hospital de Curicó is UTalca Medicine’s principal clinical teaching campus. Its official service list includes rheumatology within Medicina y Subespecialidades, giving a rheumatologist a clinical specialty presence at the faculty’s identified teaching hospital.

UTalca offers medical specializations in Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Adult Psychiatry, and Family and Community Medicine; its published list does not include a rheumatology specialty. The only open academic/research call found is outside medicine and requires residence and domicile in Chile when employment starts.
